items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: we had trombones under there with Jack Jenny and Buddy Morrow

ctx.x: They would count every part. Now then, we had trombones under there with Jack Jenny and Buddy Morrow and several other guys that could really belt it out, and those guys stood up.
We used to do this in a theater down on 46th Street, and they used to stand up and just blow it out. And you had to do that for 16 bars.

items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Jack Jenney, and his wife sang. She sang This Time The Dream's On Me-" That was recorded.

ctx.x: : But you did some things that Lips Page sang on, with Artie.

With Artie. "Blues in the Night," Take Your Shoes Off, Baby. Several other things. Johnny Guarnieri was in the band then. Georgie Auld. Les Robinson. Fine lead player. Jack Jenney, and his wife sang. She sang This Time The Dream's On Me-" That was recorded.
: I don't know her. If you say the name, I'd probably know it. Who was he married to then?
